The problem asks for the maximum possible sum of the labels on the edges of a simple graph $G$ with 11 vertices. Each edge $\{u, v\}$ is labeled with $|d_u - d_v|$, where $d_u$ and $d_v$ are the degrees of the endpoints.

Let $d_1, d_2, \dots, d_{11}$ be the degrees of the 11 vertices. The sum of the labels is given by:
$$S = \sum_{\{u,v\} \in E} |d_u - d_v|$$
Using a derivation, this sum can be rewritten in terms of the degree sequence $d_1 \ge d_2 \ge \dots \ge d_{11}$ as:
